title: CNBC Daily Open: Middle East tensions send oil higher while Iran-U.S. tensions escalate
summary_full: Concerns over supply disruptions pushed oil prices higher, amid news of recent deadly attacks on vessels in the Gulf of Oman and the Red Sea, and as a spill near Oman worsens.
